triggers.text: The estate is quiet. I am not. Meet me when you can.
triggers.note: The rescue, Hanako's state as the save shows it, and his own oath.

triggers.text: I have drunk proper tea for seven days. I thought of you. I do not know why.
triggers.note: Tea and the last meal quest.

triggers.text: Sunrise. I take mine standing. You may sit.
triggers.note: The hour and V's last night.

triggers.text: You are in Japantown. I can smell your coffee from here.
triggers.note: The district and V's last visit.

triggers.text: I heard of the trouble. Report. Briefly.
I have been thinking about loyalty. I would like your view. Over tea.
triggers.note: The pier, the clerk, and his word.

triggers.text: I wished to say nothing and found it long.
There is a tea garden above a shop in Japantown. I wish to see whether you can be taught three courtesies.
triggers.note: The tea garden, the three courtesies and the old host.

triggers.text: A small bar in Japantown has a machine that sings back. I am told this is entertainment.
triggers.note: The karaoke bar, the enka he insists on and the pop machine.

triggers.text: There is a cherry tree in a corporate garden. It is closed. I would like to see it. Politely.
triggers.note: The closed garden, the cherry tree and the guard who bows.

triggers.text: I have one coat. A man with one coat is a man in trouble. Accompany me to a tailor.
triggers.note: The tailor, the three coats and his one old coat.

triggers.text: I propose a contest. The one who speaks first loses. The loser buys tea.
triggers.note: The silence contest on the Wellsprings bench and the performer who tries to make you laugh.
